alt: Three universalist theories: great person (born with special traits), charismatic (personal appeal and vision) and transformational (followers put group goals first). The four components of transformational leadership are idealised influence, inspirational motivation, intellectual stimulation and individualised consideration, contrasted with transactional leadership. Evaluation points follow.
caption: Universalist theories say one set of qualities makes a leader everywhere.

alt: Left: the Ohio studies as two independent axes, initiating structure and consideration, with leaders high on both often seen as most effective. Right: the Michigan studies as one line from job-centred to employee-centred, with employee-centred leaders associated with more productive groups. A note evaluates both.
caption: Ohio: two separate dimensions. Michigan: originally one line with two ends.

alt: Technical problems are solved by experts with existing knowledge; adaptive challenges need people to change, so the leader mobilises them. Six numbered principles follow: get on the balcony, identify the adaptive challenge, regulate distress, maintain disciplined attention, give the work back, and protect voices of leadership from below.
caption: Adaptive leaders mobilise people to solve problems that need them to change.

alt: Nested circles: personal leadership at the core, inside private leadership, inside public leadership. Labels explain public (behaviour towards a group, such as setting a vision), private (one-to-one coaching and feedback) and personal (self-awareness, know-how and attitudes, which underpins the others).
caption: Public is the group, private is one-to-one, personal is the inner self.

alt: A two by two design crossing leader sex with masculine or feminine style, in a hospital emergency story. Contrary to role congruity theory, leaders of both sexes were rated higher with the feminine, democratic and relationship-oriented style, with no differences by leader or evaluator sex.
caption: Feminine styles were rated higher for leaders of both sexes.
